segments.name: Plinabulin pipeline
segments.description: Develops innovative cancer therapies, led by Plinabulin, for patients with high unmet medical needs.
segments.evidence: The Plinabulin pipeline focuses on developing innovative cancer therapies to improve clinical outcomes for patients who have high unmet medical needs.

segments.name: TPD platform
segments.description: Previously developed therapeutic agents using molecular glue technology through SEED, now reported as discontinued operations.
segments.evidence: The TPD platform segment was comprised of SEED's operations.

revenueModel.text: Collaboration partners pay upfront, milestone and royalty payments; the company has no product sales yet.
revenueModel.evidence: In the future, we may generate revenue from a combination of product sales, reimbursements, upfront payments, milestone payments and royalties in connection with existing and future collaborations.

changes.text: In 2024, the board approved a divestiture plan for SEED, and the TPD platform segment became discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On December 13, 2024, the Company's Board of Directors discussed and approved a divestiture plan to sell and transfer about 90 % to 100 % of the Company's interests in SEED to potential investors at a determined price.
